# @cortex-ui/agents-board

The board: task tree with contracts, agents, messages.

- **Plugin id:** `agents.board`
- **Slot:** `pane.board@1`
- **Build:** `npm run build` → `dist/` (`index.js`, `style.css`, `manifest.json`)
- **Test:** `npm test`

React, ReactDOM and `@cortex/sdk` are peer dependencies the workbench provides.

<!-- slot-contract:start (generated by ui/scripts/readme-contracts.mjs) -->
## Slot contract

- **Fills:** `pane.board@1` as `agents.board`
- **Props:** `{ active: boolean }` (whether this view is the right pane's open tab)
- **Hosts:** no slots
- **Workbench state read:** `board.focus`, `board.view`, `projectId`, `sessionId`
- **Workbench state written:** `board.view`, `projectId`, `sessionId`
- **Own durable state (survives hot swaps):** `openTasks`
- **Frame methods called:** `agents.list`, `agents.scheduler`, `memory.board.list`, `memory.board.post`, `memory.task.list`
- **Topics followed:** `agents.changed`, `memory.board.posted`, `memory.task.changed`

Styles use the theme's tokens and primitives only (`ui/verify/tokens.mjs` checks). Nothing is
imported from the renderer or from another plugin: the package builds alone (`ui/verify/standalone.mjs`).
<!-- slot-contract:end -->
